# DATA LOSS — Bug CI, production dtfs-lm (discovered 2026-06-07)

Mechanism + full forensics: PR #28; fix commits bbe6291 + cfe020f.
Incident context: plans/reports/ISSUE-SCAN-2026-06-06-2335.md (Bug CH).

## What happened

The 2026-06-06 ~20:14-21:03Z WinSCP re-upload of the media library ran a
delete-retry loop (.filepart unlink + re-transfer of identical content).
Chunks are content-addressed, so each retry re-created the SAME chunk ids
the just-unlinked file used — and the unlink delete fan-out (async, no
liveness re-check, Bug CI) swept those ids while the re-upload recommitted
them. lm-data01's fan-out completed (every live chunk deleted); fsn-data01's
stalled when its intake froze at ~20:47Z (1295 survive).

## Impact (measured 2026-06-07 ~12:00Z)

- Live namespace: 3 files, 4135 chunks (4 MiB each).
- lm-data01 (cold anchor): **0 / 4135 present** — anchor invariant at zero.
- fsn-data01 (warm): 1295 / 4135 present.
- **Missing everywhere: 2840 chunks (~11 GiB)** — all three
  movies are unreadable across large ranges. `files_missing_chunks: 0`
  is wrong (it checks state entries, not disk).
- All three files need re-upload AFTER the Bug CI fix (PR #28) is deployed.
  Re-uploading on a pre-fix binary re-arms the same race.

## Recovery checklist (v0.1.3 rollout)

1. Deploy fixed manager + data binaries everywhere (PR #27 + #28).
2. Re-upload the 3 movies (WinSCP flow is fine post-fix; the fan-out now
   skips ids any live file references — audit `delete.fanout_skipped_live`).
3. Verify: `files/inspect` per file, then per-chunk `.dat` presence on
   lm-data01 (anchor) — or run a deep scrub and check the integrity feed.
4. fsn's 414 pre-incident orphan chunks + lm's remaining orphans are Bug CB
   reaper food — leave them.
